Red-Teaming Auto Mode: Improving Blocking Classifiers Against Malign Coding Agents

We red-team the blocking monitors in Claude Code and OpenAI's Codex with an adversarial agent, and strengthen Auto Mode against the attacks we find.

Reducing Reward Hacking by Localizing Bad Behavior Instead of Penalizing It

When a model is caught cheating on a task during training, we confine its learning to a separate set of parameters. After training, we delete those parameters.

Training Alignment Auditors via Reinforcement Learning

We train LLMs to investigate target models with hidden behaviors planted in their system prompt. A trained Haiku 4.5 policy matches Opus 4.6 on held-out evaluations for auditing quality and generalizes to harder fine-tuned targets in a different scaffold.
